endorsements.name: Alissa (dnsprincess)
endorsements.label: Hey Ma’ where does malware come from?
endorsements.description: This talk discusses malware writing, sharing, and malware-as-a-service. Who writes malware, how does it find its targets, and is there a customer service line if your malware doesn’t work? These answers and more as Alissa explains the lifecycle of malware and how to get some malware yourself! Woo! Now that you know where the malware came from, what can you do about it to improve your defenses? Come see. Oh and the password is infected.
endorsements.subtitle: GrrCON 2022
